title.en: Real Madrid come back to beat Celta 2-1 as Espi's late winner makes it nine in a row
title.zh_hans: 皇马2-1逆转切尔达九连胜 艾斯皮85分钟绝杀追平巴塞

summary.en: Real Madrid came from behind to beat Celta Vigo 2-1 at home, a ninth straight win in all competitions that draws them level with leaders Barcelona. Pablo Duran put the visitors ahead after six minutes, Jude Bellingham equalised in the 66th minute, and substitute Carlos Espi scored the winner in the 85th minute. Kylian Mbappe missed a penalty but it did not cost Real, who took all three points.

Devin Booker led the way with 23 points, while Dillon Brooks and Miles Bridges added 18 apiece. The Suns scored the final six points of the game to pull away in an NBA Cup matchup in Salt Lake City.

title.en: Herro's 53 not enough as 76ers edge Bucks 132-129 for fifth straight win
title.zh_hans: 靴路轰53分仍输波 76人132-129险胜公鹿五连胜

summary.en: The Philadelphia 76ers held on for a 132-129 home win over the Milwaukee Bucks, their fifth straight victory, improving to 14-3 and staying top of the Eastern Conference. Joel Embiid posted a near triple-double with 26 points, a season-high 17 rebounds and nine assists, while LeBron James scored 13 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter. Tyler Herro scored a career-high 53 points for the Bucks but could not stop a 13th straight defeat, leaving Milwaukee at 1-16. Embiid sealed the win with two free throws with 1.5 seconds left.

summary.zh_hant: 費城76人主場以132-129險勝密爾沃基公鹿，取得五連勝，戰績14勝3負繼續領跑東岸。祖爾·艾比迪交出26分、17個籃板及9次助攻的準三雙，勒邦·占士在第四節獨取13分，全場得21分。公鹿的泰拿·靴路轟入生涯新高53分，仍無力阻止球隊吞下13連敗，戰績跌至1勝16負。艾比迪在最後1.5秒兩罰全中，為76人鎖定勝局。

title.en: Newcastle hold Arsenal to a 2-2 draw as Madueke's 78th-minute equaliser rescues the leaders
title.zh_hans: 纽卡素2-2逼和阿仙奴 马迪基78分钟救主

summary.en: Newcastle United held Premier League leaders Arsenal to a 2-2 draw at St James' Park. Eberechi Eze put Arsenal ahead in the 33rd minute, but Harvey Barnes equalised four minutes after the break after a Martin Odegaard miskick, and Malick Thiaw put Newcastle 2-1 up in the 62nd minute from a corner. Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya was then forced off injured, but Noni Madueke cut inside and scored in the 78th minute to rescue a point. Arsenal move six points clear at the top after 11 games, with 28 points, though Brighton can cut the gap to three if they beat Hull City on Sunday.
summary.zh_hans: 纽卡素主场以2-2逼和英超榜首阿仙奴。艾斯在33分钟为阿仙奴先开纪录，但换边后仅4分钟，奥迪加特一次传球失误，令班尼斯追平；迪亚在62分钟接应角球攻入第二球，纽卡素反超2-1。阿仙奴门将拉耶其后因伤退下火线，但马迪基在78分钟内切射入，为阿仙奴抢回一分。阿仙奴11战得28分，领先榜首6分，但白礼顿若在星期日击败侯城，可将分差收窄至3分。

summary.en: AS Roma thrashed Parma 5-1 away for a fourth straight Serie A win, moving to 30 points from 12 games, two behind leaders Lazio in second place. Dutch striker Donyell Malen scored four goals (39th, 68th, 77th and 90th minutes) to take his league tally to 12 for the season, while Rodrigo Mora added another in the 71st minute. Nesta Elphege had briefly levelled for the hosts in the 54th minute, but Roma scored four in the second half to seal the win.

title.en: PSG come from behind to beat Nice 3-2 as goalscorer Doue is stretchered off injured

summary.en: Paris Saint-Germain came from behind to beat Nice 3-2 away and record an eighth straight Ligue 1 win. Mohamed Amoura put the hosts ahead in the eighth minute, but Senny Mayulu's 31st-minute penalty and Desire Doue's goal a minute later turned the game around. Doue was stretchered off with a knee injury shortly after scoring, and his replacement Ferran Torres sealed the win in the 85th minute before Ali Abdi pulled one back in stoppage time. PSG have now won 12 in a row in all competitions and stay top of Ligue 1.

Bournemouth have now won nine successive matches in all competitions, a club record, and five straight top-flight games, moving to 18 points, level with Liverpool.

Taiwo Awoniyi opened the scoring in the fifth minute, Yeremy Pino levelled, Tatsuhiro Sakamoto restored Coventry's lead after half an hour, Jorgen Strand Larsen made it 2-2 in first-half stoppage time, and Dwight McNeil's own goal in the 85th minute settled it. Coventry climb to 13th with a fourth win of the season, while Palace remain bottom after a fifth straight defeat.

title.en: Leeds thrash Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge as Okafor scores twice in first win there since 1999
title.zh_hans: 利兹4-1大破切尔西 奥卡科夫梅开二度 27年首胜斯坦福桥
title.zh_hant: 列斯4-1大破車路士 奧卡科夫梅開二度 27年首勝史丹福橋

summary.en: Leeds United thrashed Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge for their first win there since 1999. Emmanuel Emegha marked his full Chelsea debut with the opener in the 25th minute, but Noah Okafor levelled three minutes later, Dominic Calvert-Lewin converted a penalty in the 53rd minute to put Leeds ahead, Okafor struck again in the 58th minute and Brenden Aaronson added a fourth in stoppage time. summary.en: Tottenham Hotspur beat Ipswich Town 2-0 at home as 18-year-old Luca Williams-Barnett starred on his first Premier League start. He opened the scoring in the 15th minute from Pedro Porro's cross and then set up Dominic Solanke for the second in the 51st minute after a mazy run. Aged 18 years and 51 days, Williams-Barnett became the second-youngest player to score and assist in a Premier League match and the youngest Tottenham scorer since Gareth Bale. Spurs recorded a fourth win of the season and a third straight home league victory to move into the top half.
